headline: Bitcoin slides below $78k, testing key liquidity while altcoins rally
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC formed a descending channel, holding the 78.2k swing high as resistance; 4H shows a lower high at 78.5k and a firm support zone around 76.8k, indicating a liquidity grab before a potential bounce.
altcoin_summary: Capital is rotating into mid‑cap alts, with DEXE, NIL, EDEN and TURBO leading gains, suggesting risk‑on sentiment despite BTC weakness.
strategy_outlook: Spot: consider buying near 76.8k support with tight stops; Futures: stay short or hedge above 78.5k until a clear break of the 78.2k swing high.
